pages.text: $(bold)EE (Elder Energy)$() is the single shared energy unit of this mod.$(br2)Everything in the pack - this mod's curse energy, Iron's Spellbooks mana and Goety soul energy - uses $(bold)one formula only$():$(br2)$(bold)1 EE = 10 mana = 40 souls = 20 curse$()$(br2)=> 1 soul = 0.025 EE, 1 curse = 0.05 EE.$(br2)$(italic)It lives in exactly one place in code ($(bold)EnergyUnits$()): the curse-to-soul fallback and the Wizard Set trait $(l:trait_all_paths_one)All Paths Are One$() both derive from it.$()

$(bold)Elder Crystal$(): capacity $(bold)1000 EE$(), stored in the item's NBT (the durability bar shows how full it is).$(br2)$(li)Hold it in your $(bold)main hand or offhand$(): while you $(bold)hold a casting item$() (or are mid-cast) and your mana is not full, it feeds mana automatically ($(bold)1 EE = 1 mana$(), at most 20 EE per tick)$(li)Crystals in your $(bold)inventory or a curio slot do not feed$() (hands only)$(li)Carrying $(bold)charged$() crystals chills you - see the next page

$(bold)Cold backlash$() (the very same freezing mechanic as powder snow):$(br2)$(li)Frozen ticks gained per tick = $(bold)ceil(2.0 x stored EE / 1000)$()$(li)A full crystal (1000 EE) gives 2/tick - fully frozen in about $(bold)3.5 s$() (the cap is 140, same as powder snow)$(li)Once fully frozen you take vanilla freeze damage: $(bold)1 point every 2 seconds$() (armour does not help - it is freezing, not a hit)$(li)$(bold)An empty crystal is not cold at all$()$(br2)$(bold)Immunity$() reuses vanilla's cold-proof gear: wear any of these in a head/chest/legs/feet slot -$(li)Leather armour (vanilla)$(li)Tinkers' $(bold)Traveler's Gear$() (4 pieces)$(li)Mekanism $(bold)MekaSuit$() (4 pieces)$(li)$(bold)Frost Robe$() (Goety)$(br2)$(italic)This mod deliberately adds $(bold)no$() anti-cold gloves - wear one of the above instead.$()

$(bold)Elder Crystal Block$(): capacity $(bold)4000 EE$() (= 4 crystals).$(br2)$(li)Breaking it drops the block itself, and the stored EE $(bold)comes with it$() (vanilla block-item mechanism: the drop carries $(italic)BlockEntityTag$(), which is restored on placing)$(li)Placed, it is a faintly glowing block$(li)$(bold)How to charge it$(): crystals do $(bold)not$() charge by themselves - put one on the $(l:elder_mana_pedestal)Mana Pedestal$() (the pedestal charges adjacent crystal blocks too)

pages.title: Recipe: 4 crystals -> 1 block
pages.text: Put $(bold)exactly 4 Elder Crystals$() in a $(bold)crafting table$() (any arrangement; a single slot holding 4 works too) to craft one Elder Crystal Block.$(br2)The output stores the $(bold)sum$() of the four crystals' EE, and $(bold)nothing is lost$(): a crystal holds 1000 and the block holds 4000 = 4 x 1000, so it always fits.$(br2)$(italic)This uses this mod's $(bold)custom merge recipe$() - ordinary recipes throw away the NBT on the ingredients, so a vanilla shapeless recipe would not do.$(br2)$(bold)It works backwards too$(): put $(bold)1 block$() in a crafting table to get $(bold)4 crystals$() back, with the block EE $(bold)split evenly$() (remainder to the first ones) - nothing lost.$()

$(bold)Elder Crystal Ore$() generates $(bold)only in the Deep Dark$().$(br2)$(li)Height: Y $(bold)-64 to -1$()$(li)Density: $(bold)2 veins per chunk$(), about $(bold)5 blocks$() each$(li)Mining yields $(bold)1 Elder Crystal$() (which comes with $(bold)500 EE$()); $(bold)Fortune$() increases the count$(li)$(bold)Silk Touch$() drops the ore block itself$(br2)$(italic)Note: the ore itself carries no energy - the EE lives in the crystal.$()
